column1: # Shared vectors for __gpy_json_flags_tail, the is_last/is_first/prev_bg JSON
# tail every IPC request builder appends. Read by all three implementations so
# the request bytes cannot drift apart:
# Format: one vector per line, tab-separated:
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. The whole-column token \e
# means the EMPTY string (an empty column would be collapsed by bash/zsh
# `read`). `prev_bg` uses the mini escape scheme of json_escape_vectors.tsv
# (backslash first: \\ -> one backslash, \n -> LF, \r -> CR, \t -> tab).
# `expected` is literal -- exactly the function's stdout, no trailing newline --
# apart from \e. Every reader MUST fail if this file is missing or yields no
# Contract: a flag is emitted only when it is literally `true` (anything else,
# including `false`, is omitted -- the agent defaults it via serde), always in
